newsitem.title: CHINA: Inner Mongolia Erdos has record high net in 1996.
newsitem.headline: Inner Mongolia Erdos has record high net in 1996.

text.p: Inner Mongolia Erdos Cashmere Products Co Ltd, the world biggest cashmere products maker, reported a record net profit in 1996 because of the high quality of their goods and the introduction of new technology.
According to international accounting standards, the company's net profit was 181.084 million yuan, up 2.8 percent from 176.156 million yuan in 1995, the company's 1996 annual report said.
"The company's profit has continued to rise since it started operation 16 years ago and 1996 net reached a historical high," the report said.
"We efficiently used proceeds from issuing B shares to update our technology, which ensured the good quality of our cashmere," it said.

The company invested $6.57 million in updating technology to make its products warmer and in some cases waterproof, the annual report said, adding it also set up a computer network linking the adminstrative and production departments to improve efficiency.
The company's board of directors proposed a pre-tax cash dividend of 0.32 yuan per share from 1996 profits, pending the approval of shareholders, the report said.
